AccountList.description: A single document, not `Page[T]`: bounded per device (proposed D22).
AccountList.title: AccountList

AppCreate.description: New apps are `active`; their default role is the built `<key>:member` (no input for it).
AppCreate.title: AppCreate

AppUpdate.description: Partial update; `key` is immutable. Explicit null is accepted only for `default_role_id`.
AppUpdate.title: AppUpdate

AssignmentCreate.description:
Assign a role at app scope (`org_id` null) or in one organization; `granted_by` is never
input (it is the actor once ADM-002 lands).
AssignmentCreate.title: AssignmentCreate

Jwk.description: OpenAPI only: the public members of one signing key.
Jwk.title: Jwk

LogoutRequest.description: Exactly one of `{account_id}` (that account) or `{all: true}` (the whole device).
LogoutRequest.title: LogoutRequest

PermissionCreate.description: `is_admin` absent or null: false, except `<app>:*` which is always stored `true`.
PermissionCreate.title: PermissionCreate

PermissionUpdate.description: Partial update; `key` is immutable. Explicit null is accepted only for `description`.
PermissionUpdate.title: PermissionUpdate

RoleCatalog.description: Public role catalog (D17). Field order is part of the ETag; append-only.
RoleCatalog.title: RoleCatalog

RoleCreate.description: New roles are never `is_system` and hold no permissions (use the PUT).
RoleCreate.title: RoleCreate

RolePermissionsReplace.description: The role's full permission set; duplicates are ignored, `[]` empties the role.
RolePermissionsReplace.title: RolePermissionsReplace

RoleUpdate.description: Partial update of the display name; `key` and `is_system` are immutable.
RoleUpdate.title: RoleUpdate

UserRead.description: Admin view of a user. Explicit fields only: never `password_hash` (R11).
UserRead.title: UserRead

UserStatusUpdate.description:
Unlike `OrganizationUpdate`, explicit null is rejected (422).

Intentional, per USR-01b AC.
UserStatusUpdate.title: UserStatusUpdate

get.description:
Cookie class (R3 class 2): `__Host-mm_device` + Origin + `X-MM-App`.

`AppContextDep` comes before `DeviceDep`: a bad app context answers 403 before any device
lookup or cookie rotation.

post.description:
Cookie class (R3 class 2): `__Host-mm_device` + Origin + `X-MM-App`; `{key}` must be the
calling app. "Continue as <account>" is the consent (D8). 200 for a new or an existing
membership (idempotent).
Public (R3 class 3: per-IP limit, Turnstile after 3 failures) + Origin/`X-MM-App` (A1).

Public (R3 class 3: per-IP limit + Turnstile) + required app context (owner 2026-11-13):
`X-MM-App` of an active app and an `Origin` registered for it (403 otherwise).

Always 202 for any email (no enumeration); per-email limits are silent. The reset link
uses the validated `Origin`; the email is queued after the commit.

Public (R3 class 3, per-IP limit): the one-time token is the credential. Ends every
account session of the user; sets no cookie and signs nobody in.

Public by design (R3 class 3): per-IP rate limit + Turnstile, plus the required app
context: `X-MM-App` of an active app and an `Origin` registered for it (403 otherwise,
before any account is created).

The verification link uses the validated `Origin`; the email is queued after the commit.
Cookie class (R3 class 2): `__Host-mm_device` + Origin + `X-MM-App`; per-app JWT (D7).
Public (R3 class 3, per-IP limit): the one-time token is the credential.
